title: A donation carries no finder's fee, whoever the donor is

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19, pricing decision card: "No, 0% on every donation" (project thread: Rethink our take rates). ADR-1978.

detail: The donation checkout priced Frequency's fee from the Space's take rate, so a donor the network introduced paid the finder's fee. It now uses DONATION_FINDERS_FEE_CENTS (0). The donor's source is still classified and stored for attribution, and the card fee still passes through to the Space from the pass-through date, as on any sale.

verify.note: Fails while the donation checkout prices its fee from the take rate.
